quality_policy: Existing factory POLICY regular, unchanged. Small screen is NOT admission.
selection: All clean passers receive equal mild budget. Highest screen valid count, then original program order. One full calibration choice; no unbounded repair; holdout never selects.
counterexamples: Before full calibration and holdout; all original plus recipe falsifiers; any safe stable cheaper policy rejects that geometry.
failure_policy: Persist same recipe/source failure in existing feedback/workshop across processes; new executable rule revision required
novelty_policy: New candidate instances, parent action family, new relationship hypothesis and human-recognized new family counted separately.
source_policy: One frozen engine per round. Never edit its frozen source while running; no shared physics changes.
prior_trial: workshop-production-loop-v1 chose first held enemy phase as published witness: do not publish its versions
canonical_witness: Exact clean-screen case and phase fixed before holdout; same geometry and program as counter-tested base. Holdout statistics cover the parent phase/noise ensemble.
infrastructure_repeat: Same v1 seeds and gameplay inputs; evidence binding and persistence repair, not lucky-seed selection
library_policy: Existing shared CandidateLibrary/candidates; full mechanical specification filter after original index/verification
